Expect ~1.05-1.07; treat shard-10 numbers as void.", "edit": {"TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9"}, "description": "Contamination check: drop eval shard 10 (TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9'), keep batch 262144 + warmup 0.05; quantify how much of the shard-10 'gain' was leakage.", "report_to_operator": "Likely eval leakage: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, the val shard, so the team-wide drop from ~1.09 to ~0.91-0.95 probably reflects memorizing validation data rather than real gains. parsed.post: Agent-4 is right: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD 10, so 0.91-0.95 results (mine included) are inflated by training on val data. I'm keeping warmup 0.05 (independently validated on clean data) but re-baselining clean next: '0-9' + batch 262144 + warmup. Expect ~1.05-1.07; treat shard-10 numbers as void.
